source_authority.document: Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
loci: Introduction: A2(n,d) is the largest binary-code size at minimum Hamming distance at least d, and R2(delta)=limsup n->infinity (1/n) log2 A2(n,ceil(delta*n)) for fixed 0<delta<1/2
Equations (1)-(3): H2, M1, g, F_delta and M2=min over 0<=tau<=1-2delta
Equation (2) and Theorem 2.3: kappa_H is the strict-feasibility whole-cube infimum and R2<=kappa_H<M1
Equations (4)-(8): constant-weight parameter domain, Lambda, strict spectral feasibility, kappa_CW, and kappa_bin=min{kappa_H,kappa_CW}
Theorem 3.8: kappa_bin(delta)<M2(delta), with the M1 endpoint handled by Theorem 2.3 and interior M2 minimizers improved by positive harmonic degrees

definition_concordance.binary_code: BinaryWord is Fin n -> Bool; hammingDist counts disagreeing coordinates; IsBinaryCode requires pairwise distance at least d, matching the source binary-code carrier and minimum-distance convention.
definition_concordance.maximum_size: Hamming.codeNumber is the finite maximum of code cardinalities over all binary codes at length n and threshold d, matching A2(n,d). codeNumber_pos is proved using a singleton code.
definition_concordance.rate: Hamming.binaryRate uses limsup atTop of log base 2 of codeNumber n (ceil(delta*n)) divided by n, matching R2(delta). The total Lean value at the finite prefix n=0 does not affect an atTop limsup.
definition_concordance.entropy_and_m1: binaryEntropy uses Real.logb 2 and agrees with source H2 on the source domain, including the source zero-log convention; classicalParameter and classicalRate are exactly the first MRRW exponent M1.
definition_concordance.whole_cube: Hamming.Feasible, rateSet and variationalRate encode 0<=b<a<=1/2, Gamma_H(a,b)>1-2delta and the H2(a)-H2(b) infimum, hence kappa_H.
definition_concordance.constant_weight: Johnson.AsymptoticParameters, spectralLimit, strict spectral feasibility, shellRate and variationalRate encode source equations (4)-(8), hence kappa_CW; combinedVariationalRate is min(kappa_H,kappa_CW)=kappa_bin.
definition_concordance.second_mrrw: mrrwG and mrrwObjective are source g and F_delta. Lean writes mrrwRate as sInf of the objective set; exists_mrrw_minimizer and mrrwRate_eq_objective_of_minimizer prove attainment on [0,1-2delta], identifying this value with the source minimum M2 under the target hypotheses.

target_audits.solution_path: mrrw_endpoint_dichotomy; whole-cube improvement handles M2=M1 and constant-weight positive-harmonic improvement handles interior minimizers

target_audits.source_relation: Theorem 1.1 gives R2<=kappa_bin<M2; the target is the transitive consequence R2<M2.

evidence: The target parameter domain 0<delta<1/2 is inhabited, for example by delta=1/4.
Hamming.codeNumber_pos proves every finite codeNumber n d is positive using a singleton code, so the logarithmic rate is not based on an empty maximum.
Hamming.rateSet_nonempty_of_interior proves the whole-cube variational set is nonempty for every 0<delta<1/2.
Johnson.rateSet_nonempty_of_interior proves the constant-weight variational set is nonempty for every 0<delta<1/2.
For 0<delta<1/2, [0,1-2delta] is nonempty; exists_mrrw_minimizer proves the MRRW objective attains its minimum on that interval.
The two positive-margin targets use explicit positive differences supplied by the strict source-faithful inequalities rather than an empty-domain implication.

disposition.basis: The source and Lean definitions agree on binary-code rate, base-2 entropy, ceiling convention, whole-cube and constant-weight variational domains, strict spectral thresholds and MRRW objective. The Lean sInf representation of M2 is tied to the source minimum by a proved minimizer theorem; all relevant variational domains are inhabited; and each of the six targets is either an exact source projection or an explicitly classified transitive/positive-margin consequence.

claim_boundary: This candidate classifies only the current-root source semantics, definition concordance, target relationships, nonvacuity and pinned formal replay evidence for the six registered OTP-B1-BINARY-CODES targets. It treats the two epsilon statements as derived certificate normal forms rather than source-printed theorems, treats the Lean sInf formulation of M2 as source-equivalent only because the exact solution proves minimizer existence and attainment under the target hypotheses, and preserves the distinction between source-semantic admission and independent proof certification.
